supported_claims: All exact target risk formula results hold under 4 source and 2 target Bernoulli independent observations.
Target shifted source oracle can have risk 7/16 versus target oracle lower bound 3/16.
Laplace source-only smoothing may mitigate shift yet incurs source estimation variance.
limitations: Oracle comparison baselines require inaccessible true population probabilities.
Only two artificially independent Bernoulli domains, no actual psychological population data.
No causal transportability evidence or live historical validation.
